## About
Mike's Z Shop sits on Painter Ave in Whittier and does one thing: Nissan, Datsun and Infinity cars. Old Z cars and new ones, plus a long list of other Nissan and Datsun models, like the Altima, Sentra, Maxima, Frontier and Hard Body pickups.
People come to us because they want more integrity and honesty than they get at the dealership. We treat every car like it's our own, and we keep a whole building full of parts for Z cars so the right piece is often already here.
Customers have given the shop a 4.9 rating from 59 Google reviews, and many of them mention Mark by name.

## Services
- Hi performance clutches: Performance clutch work for Z cars. Call for quick help figuring out what yours needs.
- Suspension and coil over suspension: Suspension work of all kinds, including coil over setups.
- A/C work: Air conditioning repair so your car is comfortable to drive.
- Transmissions: Transmission repair, plus OEM replacement and used transmissions for Z cars that fit your budget.
- Engine overhauls: Engine overhauls using quality new and used Nissan parts, done right the first time.
- Electrical: Electrical diagnosis and repair on Nissan and Datsun Z cars, with many parts kept on hand at the shop.
- Turbo and supercharger upgrades: Turbo and supercharger upgrades and installation.
- Z car parts: A whole building full of parts for Z cars. Email the shop to request what you need.

## FAQ
Q: What are your hours?
A: Tuesday through Saturday, 9 AM to 5 PM. We're closed Sunday and Monday.

Q: Do you only work on Z cars?
A: No. We also work on many other Nissan and Datsun models, including the Altima, Sentra, Maxima, Frontier, Hard Body and all pickups, along with Infinity cars.

Q: How do I request a part?
A: Send us an email at mikeszshop@msn.com and let us know what you're looking for.
